items.title: Reliquary (SN81) Post-Trained a 9B Model That Beats Qwen3.5-9B on Five Benchmarks
items.body: Reliquary post-trained Teutonic-I-Reliquary with 161 miners. The 9B model beat Qwen3.5-9B on five of eight benchmarks and scored 43.6% on SWE-bench Verified.
